credits.global-entry-tsa-precheck.note: One application-fee reimbursement up to $120 every four years for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS; charge an eligible provider directly.

perks.aeroplan-25k-status.note: Primary cardmember receives 25K status from account opening while the linked Aeroplan and card accounts remain eligible, open and not in default. Higher status earned separately is retained.

perks.first-checked-bag-free.note: Primary member and up to eight companions on the same eligible Air Canada reservation receive their first checked bag free; include the linked Aeroplan number.

perks.fly15off.note: At least 15% off the points portion of base fare on eligible Air Canada, Express or Rouge flight rewards booked directly. Taxes, fees and cash portions are excluded; log into the linked eligible Aeroplan account.

perks.aeroplan-35k-status.note: Earn Aeroplan 35K after $75,000 in calendar-year purchases; status fulfillment and duration follow Aeroplan terms.

perks.status-qualifying-credits.note: 5,000 SQC each calendar year, another 10,000 after $25,000 spent and another 10,000 after $50,000 spent that year. Maximum 25,000 SQC across eligible Aeroplan cards; these are not redeemable points.

perks.pay-yourself-back.note: Eligible purchases and point-redemption values depend on the current offer shown in your account; no fixed cash value is promised.

perks.trip-cancellation-insurance.note: Up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for eligible prepaid, nonrefundable passenger fares.

perks.baggage-delay-insurance.note: Up to $100 a day for three days for eligible essentials when baggage is delayed more than six hours.

perks.no-foreign-transaction-fee.note: No foreign transaction fee on purchases.
